messages:
sam: FYI failing to install redwood sdk in samples/python-app on CI. pip reports 'Failed building wheel for redwood-inference-sdk'.

jordan: error log?

sam: shows typing-extensions 5.0 pulled by lockfile; our pyproject pins ^4.5 so build fails. Also happens with `pip install -e .`.

lee: editable installs need PEP 660 support; if our build-backend lacks it pip falls back to building wheel and fails.

sam: reproducible steps:
```
poetry install
poetry run python -m pip install -e .
```

jordan: short fixes: regen lockfile after adding typing-extensions="<5" to dev deps OR switch CI to `pip install .` until SDK supports PEP660.

ci-bot: opened issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/261 (packaging: editable installs + typing-extensions constraints)

lee: created small README note for troubleshooting. tagging packaging team to follow up.

sam: PR incoming to pin typing-extensions <5 in sample app dev deps.
